detail.title: Kernel Governance and Durable Record Mechanisms for WAKE Process Continuity
detail.summary: This revision refines the analysis of WAKE's continuity mechanisms, acknowledging the gap between intent and current verification capabilities. The record module relies on atomic hash linking, but full verification requires reproducing the canonical state transition chain, which remains a technical challenge in the current testing environment.
detail.reason: Incorporating the observation that static code inspection does not guarantee operational atomicity under partial-failure conditions.
